lore: Old bones, sleeping in a layer of dust.
use: Brush it with the Vanilla brush for about a minute to free a dinosaur egg. Pausing makes the progress run back at twice the speed. Mine it with Silk Touch to keep the block.
secret: Which egg sleeps inside depends only on the place where the block lies.

lore: A big green egg, warm to the touch.
use: Place it and sit on it with an empty hand: 5 minutes of sitting broods it, 10 minutes later a tame T. rex hatchling hatches for the player who sat longest.
secret: Stand up too early and the warmth leaks away twice as fast as it came.

lore: A sand-coloured egg with brown bands.
use: Can be placed and brooded like every dinosaur egg. The Triceratops itself is not built yet, so it stays an egg for now.
secret: It is waiting for its dinosaur.

lore: A slate-grey egg with a pattern like small plates.
use: Can be placed and brooded like every dinosaur egg. The Stegosaurus itself is not built yet, so it stays an egg for now.
secret: It is waiting for its dinosaur.

lore: A rust-red egg with dark speckles.
use: Can be placed and brooded like every dinosaur egg. The Utahraptor itself is not built yet, so it stays an egg for now.
secret: It is waiting for its dinosaur.

lore: A teal egg with light dots.
use: Can be placed and brooded like every dinosaur egg. The Parasaurolophus itself is not built yet, so it stays an egg for now.
secret: It is waiting for its dinosaur.

lore: A saddle made for something much bigger than a horse.
use: Use it on a tamed adult dinosaur to ride it; one rider. Shaped: a saddle in the middle, 4 leather in the corners, 4 iron ingots on the sides.
secret: A normal saddle does not fit, and this one fits no horse.

lore: Boiled leather plates, cut for a skull the size of a door.
use: Use it on a tamed adult T. rex. Protection 3, like leather horse armor. 8 leather around a bone block.
secret: The bone block in the middle is the part the T. rex likes best.

lore: Riveted iron plates for a head and a back that bite back.
use: Use it on a tamed adult T. rex. Protection 5, like iron horse armor. 8 iron ingots around a bone block.
secret: The rivets are the only part that is not heavy.

lore: Diamond plates that throw the light around the cave.
use: Use it on a tamed adult T. rex. Protection 11, like diamond horse armor. 8 diamonds around a bone block.
secret: Looks best on a green T. rex.

lore: A field notebook for the finds under the sand.
use: The Simple Dinosaurs Guide explains the fossil block, the eggs and the T. rex. Craft it shapeless from a book and a bone.
secret: Its pages open in your language and nothing is consumed.
